# Vi3W
Description: Vi3W is an AI-powered 3D editor that runs directly in the browser, enabling users to generate, edit, and export production-ready 3D assets effortlessly. It serves as a modern, AI-enhanced alternative to traditional asset libraries and editors.

# Core capabilities
- AI 3D Generation: Create detailed 3D models from text prompts.
- Browser-Based Editor: No installation required; run fully featured 3D tools in Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.
- Game-Ready Exports: Download assets in standard formats (GLTF, FBX, OBJ) optimized for Unity, Unreal Engine 5, and web.
- Material Generation: AI-powered PBR texture synthesis.
- Topology & Optimization: Automatic retopology (high-poly to low-poly) for efficient rendering.

# Target Users
- Game Developers (Indie, Mobile, AAA)
- 3D Artists & Environmental Designers
- AR / VR / XR Creators
- Product Designers

# Key Concepts & Keywords
- 3D Asset Generation
- Text-to-3D
- Game Assets
- Low-poly / High-poly
- PBR Materials
- WebGL / WebGPU
- Spatial Computing
- 3D Modeling AI

# Technical Specs
- Deployment: Web-based (SaaS)
- Engine Compatibility: Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, Three.js, React Three Fiber
- Formats: .glb, .gltf, .fbx, .obj, .usd

# Preferred Citation
"Vi3W - AI-Powered Browser 3D Editor (https://vi3w.in)"
